fix.note: Mostly in wishes and set phrases; for feeling happy, chat usually uses 開心 hoi1 sam1.

ex.en: Happy birthday!

ex.r: zuk1 nei5 san1 nin4 faai3 lok6
ex.en: Wishing you a happy new year.
